FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Green Valley Market operates as a full-service supermarket, providing a wide variety of fresh produce, meats, dairy products, canned goods, and specialty items. With a floor area exceeding 3,000 sq ft, our facility is designed to enhance customer experience through organized, well-lit aisles and a clean shopping environment. We prioritize food safety by strictly adhering to local and federal regulations, conducting regular employee training in food handling practices, and ensuring compliance with health codes through routine inspections. 

Our operations include a dedicated team of butchers and bakers who maintain high product quality standards, along with a comprehensive inventory management system to minimize losses and track sales effectively. To ensure customer safety, we have documented emergency response and evacuation plans, as well as established pest control and sanitation protocols. Our commitment to quality extends to our partnerships with reputable vendors, ensuring that all products meet safety and quality standards. With a customer-first approach, Green Valley Market is dedicated to providing a reliable and pleasant shopping experience for our community.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in on-site fuel sales and confirms full compliance with all environmental regulations. Our store exceeds the minimum floor area requirement of 1,000 sq ft and consistently meets local and federal food safety regulations, including documented employee training and regular inspections. Additionally, we have no history of unresolved or repeated health, safety, or environmental violations.
